title: Push the Button
blurb: An escalating demand that something be activated immediately, which creates a small paradox: playing the clip requires pushing a button, so the instruction is satisfied by the act of receiving it. That is either poetry or a design flaw and nobody has settled it. Use it for launches, reveals, and moments requiring decisive clicking from somebody who has been hesitating for far too long. The button exists to be pushed, the demand exists to be met, and hesitating past this point is simply refusing to participate. Push the button.
origin: A viral 'push the button' demand clip.
